frequency_question: How frequently do scheduled monetary policy meetings result in a repo rate increase during typical economic normalization phases?
membership_rule: Includes all regular bi-monthly Monetary Policy Committee meeting announcements where an explicit policy rate adjustment decision is finalized and published; excludes unscheduled emergency inter-meeting rate changes.
provenance_note: 16 cases named, 36 claimed via skeleton x multiplier (2.2x)
coverage_note: 16 specific historical meeting instances detailed across representative tightening windows; estimated total population of 36 standard meetings in comparable cycles.
known_gaps: Excludes unscheduled pandemic-era emergency cuts and rare inter-meeting announcements.
skeleton: Total scheduled bi-monthly MPC meetings evaluated across active tightening phases versus total meetings where a rate hike was officially announced.
multiplier: 9 hikes across 36 evaluated standard meeting slots during active rate-adjustment horizons
validity_reason: Central bank institutional voting procedures and bi-monthly meeting schedules remain structurally stable over multi-year horizons.
